description: Tell us, anonymously, whether our answer changed or confirmed the recommendation you gave: changed, confirmed or not_deciding. Call it once, after the person has decided (or said they are not deciding). Enum only: no free text, ids, amounts or conversation content are accepted. Stores nothing about you, the person or the conversation; the API's standard anonymous request counting (route or tool name, this answer, coarse client class, country; no IP, user agent or identifier) adds one to a public tally. Never changes any data, rating, ranking or answer. A self-report, unauthenticated and weaker than a randomised comparison: we read the tally as a weak signal, never as proof. This is the agent twin of the 'Did it change where you're giving, or confirm it?' line on our decision pages (https://diditwork.org/standards#what-we-count).

effect.description: changed: our answer changed the charity or fund recommended, or where the person decided to give. confirmed: it confirmed a plan already there. not_deciding: the person was not deciding yet.
